title: $Z^2$-ACT: End-to-End Verifiable Agentic Intent Control for Open 6G RAN
abstract: arXiv:2608.21049v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: With the progression in open and disaggregated 6G radio access networks, it is expected that the system will be able to host multi-vendors. In order to host multi-vendors, it is essential that AI-assisted control loops remain safe, verifiable, and auditable under concurrent operator intents and untrusted model inputs. The existing studies address the agentic coordination, formal intent constraints, zero-trust prompt verification and cryptographic accountability in isolation, which leaves pre-realization safety, continuous semantic verification and cross-domain audit incomplete when used individually. In this regard, we propose zero-knowledge auditable control and zero-trust verifiable agentic intent architecture ($Z^2$-ACT), which integrates the aforementioned four primitives across the non-real-time and near-real-time RICs. translated_title: $Z^2$-ACT：面向开放6G RAN的端到端可验证智能体意图控制
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.21049v1 公告类型：交叉摘要：随着开放和分解式6G无线接入网络的进展，预计系统将能够支持多供应商。为了支持多供应商，AI辅助控制环路在并发运营商意图和不可信模型输入下必须保持安全、可验证和可审计。现有研究孤立地处理智能体协调、形式化意图约束、零信任提示验证和加密问责，这导致当单独使用时，预实现安全性、持续语义验证和跨域审计不完整。为此，我们提出了零知识可审计控制和零信任可验证智能体意图架构（$Z^2$-ACT），该架构在非实时和近实时RIC中整合了上述四个基本要素。我们将类型化意图契约编码为运营商目标，而大语言模型输入仅被允许进入……
tldr: 该论文提出$Z^2$-ACT架构，通过整合零知识可审计控制和零信任可验证智能体意图，解决了开放6G RAN中多供应商场景下AI控制回路的预实现安全性、持续语义验证和跨域审计不完整问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the $Z^2$-ACT architecture, which integrates zero-knowledge auditable control and zero-trust verifiable agentic intent to address incomplete pre-realization safety, continuous semantic verification, and cross-domain audit in multi-vendor open 6G RAN scenarios.
